method: Transform author ontology MRI voxel locations into each native label block using only NIfTI headers. Compare nearest present same-label voxel. Display matrices are independently checked for the same slice coordinate.
coordinateProof: Native block and MRI NIfTI affines agree with author display matrices after only in-plane rotations and optional section-order reversal (blocks 9 and 15). No guessed registration.
notAnatomicalValidation: This tests coordinate/data consistency, not the accuracy or completeness of anatomical boundaries. Author ontology points need not fall within nonconvex masks.
